subject: general
question: The second alphanumeric-cluster is obtained by changing the first alphanumeric-cluster following a certain operation and logic. The same pattern is followed in three of the following four pairs. In which of the following pairs is the pattern NOT followed?
solution:
The pattern observed in the following options:

LOGIC: Alphabets are increased to +4 positional values and the digit is multiplied by 5. 

**HP7 : LT35** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a86ab50ffba423ddf9d9f2445548fbe5b0c91ebecf08920db5250185d073c4f4.png] 

**LR9 : PU55**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9841baec57d6b3e6007c15519f1250dbe2288e748202702497b1199525a0009.png] 

**PJ3 : TN15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/576f4eaa62a49817bc331873637c1b875f31fe2a33f0db590b140dde1a881faf.png] 

**DL5 : HP25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72286a1815e280405aee64e787e807b18e0b8a32a338060b1778108db1c7944e.png] **
 

​On observing the options we find out the option which does not follow the pattern which is option 2 (LR9 : PU55.)

Hence, the correct option is ****LR9 : PU55.**
